children: On November 27, 2026, Miller Industries reported to the NYSE that Audit Committee member Peter Jackson had ceased to qualify as independent under NYSE rules after becoming chief operating officer of a company that provides consulting services to Miller Industries. Jackson resigned from the committee, and the company reported that it had regained compliance with NYSE Section 303A.06 and Exchange Act Rule 10A-3.
